_comment: SynoSharp desired-state for the shared /data NFS export on Synology volume4. Apply with: `synosharp apply stacks/Media/volume4-nfs.spec.json` (dry-run unless --confirm). Whole-list replace: EVERY client rule must be present. all_admin = all_squash → anonuid=1024/anongid=100. Clients: 10.10.0.0/16 = homelab guests (VLAN 1010); 10.0.0.0/16 = the Proxmox nodes themselves, which mount the export host-side (VLAN 1000, #37) — this rule had been added on the NAS by hand and was MISSING here, so an apply would have cut the nodes off. The legacy 192.168.179.0/24 rule was dropped from the spec 2026-09-05 (every guest still on that network is stopped); apply pending. See docs/runbooks/volume4-data-export.md.
